headline: Bitcoin slipped back below $80,000 as Asian tech stocks fell after the Fed's hawkish hold; US inflation data and Coinbase and Strategy results come later on Thursday.

market.asOf: Prices read at about 03:55 UTC Thu 29 Oct (10:55 Thursday Bangkok) from the CoinGecko homepage table: BTC $79,753, ETH $2,305, SOL $99.52. CoinGecko's bitcoin page, read two minutes later, showed $80,519 (up 0.10% in 24 hours), so the two pages disagreed. The homepage did not show the direction of the 24h change, so it is left out. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 49 (Neutral) on CoinGecko's Fear & Greed widget, read at the same time. The alternative.me index could not be read this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin dips under $80,000 as Asian tech stocks slide after a hawkish Fed
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell back below $80,000 on Thursday. A sell-off in tech stocks led by Samsung, plus the Fed's decision on Wednesday to hold rates while two officials wanted a hike, pushed traders away from riskier bets, and about $356M of leveraged crypto futures positions were forced closed.
points: About $356M of crypto futures positions were liquidated (forced closed) as bitcoin dipped under $80,000, per CoinDesk.
South Korea's Kospi fell about 3% intraday to 5,831.67 and Samsung dropped nearly 6%, per TokenPost.
Samsung fell even after reporting a record quarterly operating profit of 107.4 trillion won, per Seoul Economic Daily.
The Fed held its rate range at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, per Fox Business; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack wanted a quarter-point hike, per Cointelegraph.
CME FedWatch odds of a December hike were 78.4% at 01:12 UTC Thursday, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy report tonight, with Wall Street split on Coinbase
stories.summary: Coinbase, the US crypto exchange, reports third-quarter results after the US close on Thursday, and analysts expect a loss. Wall Street analysts disagree on how much trading came back. Strategy, which holds 848,517 bitcoin, reports the same evening. Separately, a security incident at Amplitude, an analytics company Coinbase uses, exposed contact data for some Coinbase customers; Coinbase says funds were not affected.
points: Consensus expects a loss of about $0.22 a share on revenue of about $1.20B, down 35.6% from a year ago, versus earnings of $1.44 a share a year ago, per 24/7 Wall St.
Trading volume forecasts differ: JPMorgan $173B, Barclays $147B, Oppenheimer $141B, per CoinDesk.
Strategy holds 848,517 BTC bought at an average of $75,446, and shareholders backed daily dividends on its preferred shares with 99.3% of votes, per Bitcoin Magazine.
Strategy's results webinar is at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the company; Coinbase's Q&A time is in the calendar below.

stories.title: Money trickles back into bitcoin funds but keeps leaving ether funds
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in money for a second straight day on Tuesday, while ether ETFs saw more money leave. Wednesday's flow figures were not out when this was written. A large monthly options expiry lands on Friday, which can make prices jumpy around it.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in $175.99M on Tue 27 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $151.46M and Fidelity's FBTC at $24.54M, per TokenPost.
Spot ether ETFs lost about $60M the same day, with BlackRock's ETHA down $93.3M, per BigGo Finance.
Over the last five sessions bitcoin ETFs took in $37.6M while ether ETFs lost $240.1M, per Ted Pillows' market report.
About $10.92B of bitcoin options expire on Deribit on Friday at 08:00 UTC, with 'max pain' at $78,000, per KuCoin. Max pain is not a price target.

briefs.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55%
briefs.summary: Robinhood reported Q3 revenue of $1.42B, but crypto revenue fell 55% from a year earlier to $120M, and prediction markets brought in $173M, per The Block.

briefs.title: Ripple wins final approval for a US trust bank
briefs.summary: Ripple got the final go-ahead from the OCC, a US bank regulator, to launch a national trust bank, which will hold the reserves behind its RLUSD stablecoin, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Coinbase adds Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
briefs.summary: Coinbase listed Ripple's dollar stablecoin RLUSD across its retail app, Exchange and Prime, per The Block.

briefs.title: Datavault AI says it can't get its bitcoin back
briefs.summary: Datavault AI's stock fell 49.55% after it said it cannot withdraw bitcoin held at the exchange Biconomy and will restate four sets of financial reports, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Midterms could change crypto policy
briefs.summary: Kalshi bettors give Democrats about a 64% chance of winning the Senate in next week's midterm elections, and the stalled Clarity Act market-structure bill may lose priority, per The Block.
